questions.q: The poison that causes garlic odour of breath and 'rice-water' stools resembling cholera is:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Acute arsenic poisoning.

questions.q: A 'rat-tail' appearance on barium swallow is seen in (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. Achalasia gives the bird's-beak appearance.

questions.q: Haematuria, proteinuria, oedema and hypertension after a sore throat in a child suggest:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. One to three weeks after a streptococcal infection.

questions.q: A fastidious, exacting patient who cannot bear disorder, with burning pains relieved by heat, needs:
questions.why: Arsenicum album is the classic fastidious remedy, with burning pains better by heat and restless anxiety.

questions.q: 'The Genius of Homoeopathy: Lectures and Essays on Homoeopathic Philosophy' was written by:
questions.why: Stuart Close (1860-1929) published The Genius of Homoeopathy in 1924.

questions.q: Hahnemann discovered the prophylactic use of Belladonna in:
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Published in 1801 on scarlet fever.

questions.q: Under IMNCI, fast breathing in a child aged 2 to 12 months is a respiratory rate of:
questions.why: Cut-offs are 60/min under 2 months, 50/min for 2–12 months and 40/min for 1–5 years.

questions.q: A sudden rise in blood pressure is corrected within seconds mainly by the:
opts: Baroreceptor reflex from the carotid sinus and aortic arch
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Baroreceptors buffer short-term changes; the kidneys set long-term pressure.

questions.q: Bell's 'Homoeopathic Therapeutics of Diarrhoea' is classified as a:
Which remedy is regarded as the chronic of Aconite?
questions.why: Sulphur is the chronic of Aconite: it continues the work of Aconite in deeper, slower states.
